ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE_PROCESSING
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve_processing IS
 cursor c1 is 
 select drive_id,drive_date,drive_type,location_id,recruiter_id,projected_show,projected_draw,
 schedule_stup_bkdown_time from drives
 where drive_date between :s_from_date and :s_to_date
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 -- and drive_type in (decode(:control_block.drive_type,'B','(''I','C'')',:control_block.drive_type))
 and drive_type = :control_block.drive_type
 and status = 'CNFRM'
 and recruiter_id = nvl(:control_block.s_recruiter_id,recruiter_id) ;

 act_cpu number ;
 proj_cpu number ;
 E_err_flag varchar2(1) := 'N';
 err_flag varchar2(1) := 'N';

 err_msg varchar2(70) ;
 all_drives number := 0;
 ocost_drives number := 0;
BEGIN
 go_block('DRIVES') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 clear_block ;

 clear_message ;
 message('Working ...',no_acknowledge) ;
 --pitss synchronize ;

 for c1rec in c1 loop
 all_drives := all_drives + 1 ;
 E_err_flag := 'N' ;
 don_cost_analysis.calc_proj_cost(c1rec.drive_id,c1rec.location_id,c1rec.schedule_stup_bkdown_time,proj_cpu,E_err_flag) ;
 if E_err_flag = 'Y' then
 message('Error:'||c1rec.drive_id||', contact IS ') ; 
 end if;
 don_cost_analysis.calc_act_cpu(c1rec.drive_id,:global.chapter_id,act_cpu,err_flag,err_msg) ;
 if err_flag = 'Y' then
 message(err_msg||' for '||c1rec.drive_id||', contact IS ') ; 
 pause ;
 else
 if (:option='O' and act_cpu >= :control_block.optimal_cpu and proj_cpu >= :control_block.ecpu) or
 (:option='B' and act_cpu < :control_block.optimal_cpu and proj_cpu < :control_block.ecpu) or
 (:option ='A')
 then
 ocost_drives := ocost_drives + 1 ;

 :drives.drive_id := c1rec.drive_id ;
 :drives.drive_date := c1rec.drive_date ;
 :drives.drive_type := c1rec.drive_type ;
 :drives.proj_show := c1rec.projected_show ;
 :drives.proj_draw := c1rec.projected_draw ;
 :drives.cpu := round(act_cpu,2) ;
 :drives.ecpu := proj_cpu ;

 :drives.seq_no := ocost_drives ;
 /*-- Get Recruiter Name --*/
 begin
 select Initcap(first_name||' '||last_name) into :drives.recruiter_name
 from employees
 where staff_no = c1rec.recruiter_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 begin
 select Initcap(location_name) into :drives.site_name
 from locations
 where location_id = c1rec.location_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 begin
 select count(*),sum(decode(unit_id,null,0,1))
 into :actual_show,:actual_draw
 from donations
 where drive_id = c1rec.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 begin
 select count(*),sum((out_time-in_time)*24)
 into :staff,:staff_hours
 from drive_employees
 where drive_id = c1rec.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and nvl(staff_type,'*') != 'STDNT' ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;

 next_record ;
 end if ; 
 end if ;
 end loop ;

 :all_drives := all_drives ;
 :ocost_drives := ocost_drives ;
 clear_message ;
 first_record ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_DRIVE_QUERY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE call_drive_query IS
BEGIN
if :drives.drive_id is not null then
 begin
 select sponsor_id into :global.p_sponsor_id
 from drive_sponsors
 where drive_id = :drives.drive_id
 and rownum = 1;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 :global.p_drive_id := :drives.drive_id ;
 run_other_form('MCQDRIVE','X') ;
end if ;
END;
